name: Select
title: Select
summary: A field-styled dropdown button with a caret that opens a short listbox of fixed options 6px below the field.
whenToUse: Pick one value from 2–10 fixed options (contact topic, gift fund, country of a short list).
2–5 options that should all stay visible: use Radio instead.
Long or searchable lists (languages, countries): use Combobox.
Picking several: use MultiSelect or `.check` rows.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label shown above the field.

props.name: options
props.description: The fixed options (2 to 10 works best).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown while nothing is chosen, for example "Choose a topic".

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint under the field. Replaced by `error`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Sets `aria-invalid="true"` on the trigger and links the message with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: optional
props.description: Mark the label with the optional marker.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. When set, a hidden input submits the chosen value.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Class on the outer `.field` wrapper. `className` goes on the trigger button.

variantNotes: Open: `aria-expanded="true"` gives the blue border and focus ring and rotates the caret 180°.
Selected option: `aria-selected="true"`, semibold `--horizon-blue-dim` text and a blue tick on the right.
Error: `aria-invalid="true"` on the button and an `.err` line below.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: The caret ⌄ means "opens here". Never use ↗ or › on a select.
Options are 44px rows with 8px (`--radius-sm`) corners inside 6px panel padding.
Show exactly one check, on the selected option only.
Close the list on pick, on Esc and on blur; keep focus on the trigger.
Use the native `<select class="input">` when you need no custom styling inside the list, e.g. inside the dot.Bible app on low-end devices.
Do not put links or actions inside the list.

accessibility: Trigger: `aria-haspopup="listbox"` and `aria-expanded`. Name it with `aria-labelledby` pointing at the label and itself, so the current value is read.
Keys: Enter / Space / Alt+Down opens; Up/Down moves; Enter picks; Esc closes.
content: Options: General question, Partnership, Broadcast partner, Publishing or NFC order, Prayer request.
Use sentence case; keep options to a few words.
